messages:
noah: Quick follow-up from the 3/15 postmortem 1: we shipped the writeup but need concrete runbook/playbook guardrails: (A) explicit triage commands, (B) unambiguous escalation steps, (C) remediation owners + dates, (D) a short recurring check to catch the eviction ramp early. Who can pick pieces up?
anya: Ill take A (triage commands) and include a minimal reproducible detection query + a one-liner to surface evictions.
sam-oncall: Ill take B (escalation). There was confusion on whether to page infra or platform for cross-pool pressure. Ill add a strict RACI and an emergency autodial fallback.
anya: Planned triage snippets to add to runbook:
```sh
# pods with eviction events
kubectl get events --all-namespaces --field-selector reason=Evicted -o json | jq '.items[] | {ns:.metadata.namespace, pod:.involvedObject.name, msg:.message}'
# short eviction rate check (prometheus)
curl -s "$PROM/api/v1/query?query=sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m])) by (pool)"
```
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-5123: "Postmortem follow-up - runbook guardrails & escalation" assigned to anya,sam-oncall. Due 2025-04-08.
clare: Ill review for customer-facing impact and prep a short comms draft if needed. Also suggest adding a canary probe to dedicated pools.
sam-oncall: Canary probe snippet I'll add to playbook:
```yaml
readinessProbe:
  exec:
    command: ["/bin/sh","-c","curl -sf http://localhost:8080/health || exit 2"]
  periodSeconds: 30
  failureThreshold: 3
```
infra-bot: Linked INF-5123 -> INF-5124 (add canary probe + dashboard), created INF-5125 (escalation roster update).
anya: ETA for triage PR: EOD tomorrow. Will include commands, dashboard links, and a short "how to validate" checklist for drills.
sam-oncall: ETA for escalation RACI + roster: 3 business days. Will add autodial fallback and a 2-minute page ack rule.
clare: ETA for comms review: 48 hours. Ill flag anything customer-visible.
noah: Recap: anya -> triage PR by EOD tomorrow; sam-oncall -> escalation + roster in 3 days; clare -> comms review in 48h; infra-bot/ops-bot -> tickets tracking. Schedule a 2-week verification drill to validate changes and watch for recurrence.
ops-bot: Scheduled follow-up reminder for INF-5123 on 2025-04-22.
noah: Thanks 1, when PRs land well close INF-5123 and update the runbook index."
